implementation.method: Same-process identical-entry-state native replay with page-granular snapshots and touched-byte exit comparison.

candidate.description: 16-iteration fractional MAC/MSAC core producing four 32-bit values per iteration

stock_audio_target.workload: generated slot-1 sample with held Trig 1

conclusion: The inner loop is a bounded replayable accelerator candidate. These results prove identical native replay at the boundary, not replacement correctness or speedup.
next_gate: Implement an optional QEMU whole-loop helper and require identical access, exit-register, and touched-memory results against the native oracle before measuring throughput.

github_actions.policy: Validate locally and publish with [skip ci].

safety: Only aggregate counts and instruction-boundary addresses are committed. No Elektron firmware, project data, sample names, PCM, runtime values, or runtime trace is committed.
